sanskrit: ya ṛte cidabhiśriṣaḥ purā jatrubhya ātṛdaḥ . sandhātā sandhiṃ maghavā purūvasurniṣkartā vihrutaṃ punaḥ
english: He who, even without libation, was wounded before through the collar-bones — Maghavan, the generous one, is the joiner of joints, the restorer of what is dislocated.

sanskrit: ā tvā sahasramā śataṃ yuktā rathe hiraṇyaye . brahmayujo haraya indra keśino vahantu somapītaye
english: A thousand, yea a hundred, harnessed to the golden car — let the prayer-yoked, maned bay steeds bring you, O Indra, to drink the soma.

sanskrit: ā mandrairindra haribhiryāhi mayūraromabhiḥ . mā tvā ke cinni yemurinna pāśino 'ti dhanveva tāṃ ihi
english: Come, O Indra, with your gladdening bay steeds whose hairs are like peacock-feathers. Let no one hold you back, let no bonds restrain you; pass over them as over a desert and come.

sanskrit: tvamaṅga pra śaṃsiṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyam . na tvadanyo maghavannasti marḍitendra bravīmi te vacaḥ
english: You, the god most mighty, truly do praise the mortal. There is none other than you, O Maghavan, to show mercy — I speak this word to you, O Indra.

sanskrit: tvamindra yaśā asyṛjīṣī śavasaspatiḥ . tvaṃ vṛtrāṇi haṃsyapratīnyeka itpurvanuttaścarṣaṇīdhṛtiḥ
english: You, O Indra, are famed as the straight-pressing lord of strength. You alone slay the obstructing Vṛtras, you who drive forward the unyielding, the upholder of all peoples.

sanskrit: indramiddevatātaya indraṃ prayatyadhvare . indraṃ samīke vanino havāmaha indraṃ dhanasya sātaye
english: For the divine company we call Indra; we call Indra at the sacrifice being performed; we call Indra in the battle for the spoil; we call Indra for the winning of wealth.

sanskrit: imā u tvā purūvaso giro vardhantu yā mama . pāvakavarṇāḥ śucayo vipaścito 'bhi stomairanūṣata
english: May these praises of mine increase you, O Purūvasas. The bright-toned, pure, and wise ones have sung forth praise-hymns to you.

sanskrit: udu tye madhumattamā gira stomāsa īrate . satrājito dhanasā akṣitotayo vājayanto rathā iva
english: These sweetest praises and lauds rise up, conquerors of wealth altogether, with inexhaustible bounty, striving for the prize like chariots.

sanskrit: yathā gauro apā kṛtaṃ tṛṣyannetyaveriṇam . āpitve naḥ prapitve tūyamā gahi kaṇveṣu su sacā piba
english: As a wild bull, thirsting, goes to the water that has been gathered not yet drunk — come swiftly to us in the time of drinking and before the feast; among the Kaṇvas drink well in fellowship.

sanskrit: bhagaṃ na hi tvā yaśasaṃ vasuvidamanu śūra carāmasi
english: As one follows Bhaga, so we follow you, O hero, glorious and the finder of wealth.

sanskrit: yā indra bhuja ābharaḥ svarvāṃ asurebhyaḥ . stotāraminmaghavannasya vardhaya ye ca tve vṛktabarhiṣaḥ
english: The goods you brought away, O Indra, the heavenly wealth from the asuras — increase the praiser thereof, O Maghavan, and those who have strewn the sacred grass for you.

sanskrit: pra mitrāya prāryamṇe sacathyamṛtāvaso . varūthye3 varuṇe chandyaṃ vacaḥ stotraṃ rājasu gāyata
english: Sing forth the companionable truth-guarded speech to Mitra and Aryaman; sing the delightful praise, the sheltering hymn, to the royal Varuṇa.

sanskrit: abhi tvā pūrvapītaya indra stomebhirāyavaḥ . samīcīnāsa ṛbhavaḥ samasvaranrudrā gṛṇanta pūrvyam
english: The Āyus who first drank the soma have praised you, O Indra, with hymns; the Ṛbhus, joining their voices together, and the Rudras chant the ancient praises.

sanskrit: pra va indrāya bṛhate maruto brahmārcata . vṛtraṃ hanati vṛtrahā śatakraturvajreṇa śataparvaṇā
english: O Maruts, sing the mighty prayer to great Indra. The slayer of Vṛtra, the hundred-powered one, smites Vṛtra with the hundred-jointed thunderbolt.

sanskrit: bṛhadindrāya gāyata maruto vṛtrahantamam . yena jyotirajanayannṛtāvṛdho devaṃ devāya jāgṛvi
english: Sing aloud, O Maruts, to Indra the mightiest slayer of Vṛtra — by whom the truth-exalting gods generated the light, the wakeful one for the god's sake.

sanskrit: indra kratuṃ na ā bhara pitā putrebhyo yathā . śikṣā ṇo asminpuruhūta yāmani jīvā jyotiraśīmahi
english: Bring us wisdom, O Indra, as a father brings to his sons. Instruct us, O much-invoked one, in this journey, that we may live and attain light.

sanskrit: mā na indra parā vṛṇagbhavā naḥ sadhamādye . tvaṃ na ūtī tvaminna āpyam mā na indra parā vṛṇak
english: Do not turn away from us, O Indra; be near us in the common feast. You are our help, you are our kinship — do not turn away from us, O Indra.

sanskrit: vayaṃ gha tvā sutāvanta āpo na vṛktabarhiṣaḥ . pavitrasya prasravaṇeṣu vṛtrahanpari stotāra āsate
english: We who have pressed soma and have strewn the sacred grass sit around you like waters around the pure filter, O Vṛtra-slayer; the praisers attend you.

sanskrit: yadindra nāhuṣīṣvā ojo nṛmṇaṃ ca kṛṣṭiṣu . yadvā pañca kṣitīnāṃ dyumnamā bhara satrā viśvāni pauṃsyā
english: Whatever strength and manly power you have, O Indra, among the Nahuṣa peoples, or whatever brilliance you have among the five peoples — bring it here; bring all manly powers together.

sanskrit: vṛṣā hyugra śṛṇviṣe parāvati vṛṣo arvāvati śrutaḥ
english: For you, the mighty bull, are heard in the distant regions; the bull is famed in the near regions.

sanskrit: yacchakrāsi parāvati yadarvāvati vṛtrahan . atastvā gīrbhirdyugadindra keśibhiḥ sutāvāṃ ā vivāsati
english: Whether you are in the far region or in the near, O Vṛtra-slayer, O Śakra — even from there the soma-presser seeks you with hymns, O long-maned Indra, day by day.

sanskrit: abhi vo vīramandhaso madeṣu gāya girā mahā vicetasam . indraṃ nāma śrutyaṃ śākinaṃ vaco yathā
english: Sing with the great hymn to the hero exhilarated by soma-draughts, the all-knowing one — Indra, renowned by name, the mighty one, as a word is heard.

sanskrit: indra tridhātu śaraṇaṃ trivarūthaṃ svastaye . chardiryaccha maghavadbhyaśca mahyaṃ ca yāvayā didyumebhyaḥ
english: O Indra, grant the triple-seated shelter, the triple-protected refuge for well-being. Grant protection to the Maghavans and to me; ward off the missiles from us.

sanskrit: śrāyanta iva sūryaṃ viśvedindrasya bhakṣata . vasūni jāto janimānyojasā prati bhāgaṃ na dīdhimaḥ
english: As all things lean toward the sun, all partake of Indra's bounty. Born with strength through his births, we look toward our share as our due.

sanskrit: na sīmadeva āpa tadiṣaṃ dīrghāyo martyaḥ . etagvā cidyā etaśo yuyojata indro harī yuyojate
english: No god, no long-lived mortal has attained that power. Even as the swift steed Etaśa is harnessed, so Indra harnesses his two bay steeds.

sanskrit: ā no viśvāsu havyamindraṃ samatsu bhūṣata . upa brahmāṇi savanāni vṛtrahanparamajyā ṛcīṣama
english: Adorn Indra, the invocable, in all our battles; approach the prayers and the soma-pressings, O Vṛtra-slayer with highest bow — we have sung our hymn.

sanskrit: tavedindrāvamaṃ vasu tvaṃ puṣyasi madhyamam . satrā viśvasya paramasya rājasi na kiṣṭvā goṣu vṛṇvate
english: Yours indeed, O Indra, is the lowest wealth, yours you nourish the middle; you reign altogether over the highest of all; none bars you in matters of cattle.

sanskrit: kveyatha kvedasi purutrā ciddhi te manaḥ . alarṣi yudhma khajakṛtpurandara pra gāyatrā agāsiṣuḥ
english: Where are you now, where do you stand? For your mind ranges widely. You are roused, O warrior, breaker of the crooked ones, destroyer of citadels — the Gāyatra singers have praised you.

sanskrit: vayamenamidā hyopīpemeha vajriṇam . tasmā u adya savane sutaṃ bharā nūnaṃ bhūṣata śrute
english: We have indeed fattened him here, the thunderbolt-bearer. For him therefore bring today at the pressing the pressed soma; truly adorn him who is renowned.

sanskrit: viśvāsāṃ tarutā pṛtanānāṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ yo vṛtrahā gṛṇe
english: I praise the overcomer of all armies, the mightiest, the slayer of Vṛtra.

sanskrit: yata indra bhayāmahe tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi . maghavañchagdhi tava tanna ūtaye vi dviṣo vi mṛdho jahi
english: From where we fear, O Indra, from there make us fearless. Enable that, O Maghavan, for our protection; smite away enemies, smite away the foes.

sanskrit: vāstoṣpate dhruvā sthūṇāṃ satraṃ somyānām . drapsaḥ purāṃ bhettā śaśvatīnāmindro munīnāṃ sakhā
english: O Lord of the homestead, you are the firm pillar, the constant protector of the soma-drinkers. The drop that breaks the everlasting citadels — Indra is the friend of the sages.

sanskrit: baṇmahāṃ asi sūrya baḍāditya mahāṃ asi . mahaste sato mahimā paniṣṭama mahnā deva mahāṃ asi
english: Truly you are great, O Sun; truly you are great, O Āditya. Your greatness is wondrous as you exist, O most admirable; by your greatness, O god, you are great.

sanskrit: aśvī rathī surūpa idgomāṃ yadindra te sakhā . śvātrabhājā vayasā sacate sadā candrairyāti sabhāmupa
english: The one with horses and chariot, of beautiful form, wealthy in cattle — such is your friend, O Indra; he partakes of food shared with dogs and always goes with brilliant companions to the assembly.

sanskrit: yaddyāva indra te śataṃ śataṃ bhūmīruta syuḥ . na tvā vajrintsahasraṃ sūryā anu na jātamaṣṭa rodasī
english: If there were a hundred heavens of yours, O Indra, and a hundred earths — a thousand suns could not equal you, O bearer of the thunderbolt; neither could the two worlds that were born encompass you.

sanskrit: yadindra prāgapāgudagnyagvā hūyase nṛbhiḥ . simā purū nṛṣūto asyānave 'si praśardha turvaśe
english: Whether you are called eastward or westward, northward or led by men, O Indra — truly you are mighty, born of men; you belong to Anava and to Turvaśa, O foremost of hosts.

sanskrit: kastamindra tvā vasavā martyo dadharṣati . śraddhā hi te maghavanpārye divi vājī vājaṃ siṣāsati
english: What mortal with wealth dares to challenge you, O Indra? For faith in you, O Maghavan, prevails in the farther heaven; the prize-winning steed ever seeks its prize.

sanskrit: indrāgnī apādiyaṃ pūrvāgātpadvatībhyaḥ . hitvā śiro jihvayā rārapaccarattriṃśatpadā nyakramīt
english: This footless one came before those with feet, O Indra and Agni. Having left its head, it has cooked and moved with its tongue, going thirty-footed downward.

sanskrit: indra nedīya edihi mitamedhābhirūtibhiḥ . ā śaṃ tama śaṃ tamābhirabhiṣṭibhirā svāpe svāpibhiḥ
english: Come nearer, O Indra, with measured, wisdom-filled aids. Come with the most beneficial of conquering powers, with the best of sleep-giving gifts.

sanskrit: āśuṃ jetāraṃ hetāraṃ rathītamamatūrtaṃ tugriyāvṛdham
english: The swift one, the conqueror, the thrower, the best charioteer, the unhurried one, the increaser of Tugriya — him I praise.

sanskrit: mo ṣu tvā vāghataśca nāre asmanni rīraman . ārāttādvā sadhamādaṃ na ā gahīha vā sannupa śrudhi
english: May the worshippers not cause you to stray far from us. Come from afar to the common feast, or being here, hear us well.

sanskrit: sunota somapāvne somamindrāya vajriṇe . pacatā paktīravase kṛṇudhvamitpṛṇannitpṛṇate mayaḥ
english: Press out the soma for the soma-drinking, thunderbolt-bearing Indra. Cook the foods for his protection; truly he who gives fills the giver with joy.

sanskrit: yaḥ satrāhā vicarṣaṇirindraṃ taṃ hūmahe vayam . sahasramanyo tuvinṛmṇa satpate bhavā samatsu no vṛdhe
english: We call on Indra, the all-conquering, all-seeing one. O you of a thousand angers, of great might, lord of the good — be our increaser in battles.

sanskrit: śacībhirnaḥ śacīvasū divānaktaṃ diśasyatam . mā vāṃ rātirupa dasatkadā ca nāsmadrātiḥ kadā ca na
english: O you two who are wealthy in powers, direct your powers to us day and night. May your bounty never fail, and may our gift to you never fail at any time.

sanskrit: yadā kadā ca mīḍhuṣe stotā jareta martyaḥ . ādidvandeta varuṇaṃ vipā girā dharttāraṃ vivratānām
english: Whenever a mortal praiser calls out to the bountiful one, he should approach Varuṇa with inspired speech and voice — Varuṇa, the upholder of those who have gone astray.

sanskrit: pāhi gā andhaso mada indrāya medhyātithe . yaḥ sammiślo haryoryo hiraṇyaya indro vajrī hiraṇyayaḥ
english: Protect the cattle with the intoxication of the soma-juice for Indra, O Medhyātithi — he who is mingled with the two bay steeds, the golden one; Indra, the thunderbolt-bearer, the golden one.

sanskrit: ubhayaṃ śṛṇavacca na indro arvāgidaṃ vacaḥ . satrācyā maghavāntsomapītaye dhiyā śaviṣṭha ā gamat
english: May Indra hear both things and this word of ours spoken here. May Maghavan, the all-conquering one, come with wisdom for the drinking of soma, O mightiest one.

sanskrit: mahe ca na tvādrivaḥ parā śulkāya dīyase . na sahasrāya nāyutāye vajrivo na śatāya śatāmagha
english: You who hold the stone are not given away from us for a great price, nor for a thousand, nor for ten thousand, O thunderbolt-bearer, nor for a hundred, O you who have hundreds of gifts.

sanskrit: vasyāṃ indrāsi me pituruta bhrāturabhuñjataḥ . mātā ca me chadayathaḥ samā vaso vasutvanāya rādhase
english: You are better to me than a father and than a brother who does not support; you and my mother delight me equally, O Vasu, for the attainment of wealth.
